create_distributed_sampler: create a DistributedSampler instance to split a dataset across multiple processes for distributed training
create_node_distributed_sampler: create a NodeDistributedSampler instance to partition dataset samples by local node rank for multi-node training
set_epoch_distributed_sampler: set the epoch on a DistributedSampler to change the deterministic shuffle seed for a new training epoch
iterate_distributed_sampler: iterate over a DistributedSampler to get the subset of dataset indices assigned to the current process rank
review_sampler_classes: review the DistributedSampler and NodeDistributedSampler classes to understand how they partition datasets for distributed training
